metadata.question: Did the burned area north and west of Pacific Palisades, California increase between January 6, 2025 and January 14, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Pacific Palisades, California (approximately 34.05°N, 118.54°W) - Need to define area "north and west" of this point - Dates: January 6, 2025 vs January 14, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for burned area detection using NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) - Alternative: MODIS burned area products or Landsat 8/9 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get accurate burn detection - Use NBR = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) - Lower NBR values indicate burned areas - Calculate difference in burned area between the two dates 3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after cloud masking - C3: If NBR calculation fails or produces invalid values - A: If burned area increased (more pixels with low NBR on Jan 14) - B: If burned area did not increase or decreased ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Pacific Palisades location and area north and west const pacificPalisades = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.54, 34.05]); const areaOfInterest = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-118.70, 34.05], [-118.70, 34.20], [-118.54, 34.20], [-118.54, 34.05], [-118.70, 34.05]] ]); // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NBR function addNBR(image) { const nbr = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B12']).rename('NBR'); return image.addBands(nbr); } // Get Sentinel-2 data for January 6, 2025 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(areaOfInterest) .filterDate('2025-01-05', '2025-01-07') .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNBR); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 6 Images: ${size1}`); if (size1 === 0) { col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(areaOfInterest) .filterDate('2025-01-04', '2025-01-08') .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNBR); const size1b = col1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 6 Extended Images: ${size1b}`); if (size1b === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // Get Sentinel-2 data for January 14, 2025 let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(areaOfInterest) .filterDate('2025-01-13', '2025-01-15') .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNBR); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 14 Images: ${size2}`); if (size2 === 0) { col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(areaOfInterest) .filterDate('2025-01-12', '2025-01-16') .map(maskS2clouds) .map(addNBR); const size2b = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 14 Extended Images: ${size2b}`); if (size2b === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // Create median composites const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // Count valid pixels for both dates const count1 = img1.select('NBR').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: areaOfInterest, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.select('NBR').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: areaOfInterest, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 6 Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Jan 14 Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate burned area (NBR < 0.1 threshold) const burnThreshold = 0.1; const burned1 = img1.select('NBR').lt(burnThreshold); const burned2 = img2.select('NBR').lt(burnThreshold); // Calculate burned pixel counts const burnedArea1 = burned1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: areaOfInterest, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); const burnedArea2 = burned2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: areaOfInterest, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NBR').getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 6 Burned Pixels: ${burnedArea1}`); console.log(`Jan 14 Burned Pixels: ${burnedArea2}`); if (burnedArea1 === null || burnedArea2 === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (burnedArea2 > burnedArea1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
